Fig. 2. Architecture of the ANCHOR System: (i) Schema-agnostic extraction preprocesses CTI documents and extracts entities, coreferences, and triplets without binding to a fixed ontology schema; (ii) Hybrid ontology discovery maps each entity and predicate to an ontology class or property URI via embedding search when confidence meets τ , or recursive navigation otherwise; (iii) Knowledge graph construction applies SHACL validation with closed-loop self-correction to build an ontology-aligned threat knowledge graph.
